title: 第13章 撸串就得专心撸第14章 鼠巢
content_zh:
;;
像这种联谊聚会，作为一个宅男，云阳确实是参与的不多。
不过做僚机嘛，云阳还是懂得。
吕小布曾言：僚机的工作就是要辅助主机完成打击目标，并在危险时不惜牺牲自身掩护主机撤退。
烧烤摊上，八个人围在两张小桌拼成的“大桌”上，桌上还有个小烤炉。
这家烧烤店是店家送上来半熟的各种烤串，食客再在桌上用桌上的小烤炉烤熟。
店家出餐的速度快了，出餐的压力小了，食客觉得味道不好也可以推脱到“食客自己没烤好”身上了。
但大部分“大学生”还挺喜欢这种自己动手的感觉了，对此云阳只能说这也是周瑜打黄盖，一个愿打一个愿挨了。
“来云阳，这串烤好了，快尝尝。”说着，刘洋洋从小烤炉上拿过来几串烤好的肉串放在云阳面前。
“……我这还没吃完呢。”
“有啥要紧的嘛，多吃点呗。”
云阳看着自己餐具旁那已经堆起来的铁签子，心中莫名浮现出一种被坑了的感觉。
自己不是来做僚机的吗？怎么特么的感觉快成主机了？
再看看张古那家伙。
坐在黑长直李子然对面的张古，殷勤是殷勤了，但那个李子然似乎并不怎么领情，偶尔的回复一句不咸不淡的“嗯。”、“啊。”、“是吗？”，对张古相当的不感冒。
云阳与薛子杰和赵江对视一眼，三人眉头微皱。
今天这局不对啊，到底是谁给谁当僚机呢？
云阳扬了扬下巴，示意道：诸爱卿快快出些主意啊！
薛子杰看向云阳，用眼神示意道：陛下，事已至此，要不转换一下目标，把你当成主机算了。
当你妹啊！关我屁事啊！

云阳朝张古努了努嘴。
别忘了今天晚上的主要任务！是帮张古那小子！
随即，云阳朝薛子杰和赵江两人挑眉示意道：我这边库库吃，他那边献殷勤也没用，眼看着场子冷了，你们快点发挥些主观能动性，找点话题啊先！
话题？
赵江心生一计，向不远处的网吧门店又看向云阳，以眼神示意道：不如聊游戏如何？
……
小赵是谁招进来的？拖出去斩了！
你看看对面四个女生，一个大大咧咧天天混迹于男生群体的合法萝莉，一个金发波浪时髦妹，一个黑长直ik女，还有一个高挑单马尾白月光，你猜猜这里面谁最有可能是喜欢打游戏的？
你这不是把朕往火坑里推吗？
把小赵的尸体再拉出去鞭尸一顿！
“啪！”
薛子杰拍了下云阳的肩膀。
content_en:
;;
As an otaku, Yunyang did not participate in many social gatherings like this.
But Yunyang still understands being a wingman.
Lu Xiaobu once said: The wingman's job is to assist the host in completing the target, and to protect the host's retreat at the expense of himself when in danger.
At the barbecue stall, eight people gathered around a "big table" made up of two small tables, with a small oven on the table.
In this barbecue restaurant, the store delivers a variety of half-cooked kebabs, and the diners grill them on the table in a small oven on the table.
The store can serve the food faster and the pressure of serving the food is reduced. If the food tastes bad, the diners can blame it on "the diners themselves didn't bake it well".
But most "college students" quite like the feeling of doing it themselves. Yunyang can only say that this is Zhou Yu's slap in the face, and one is willing to fight and the other is willing to suffer.
"Come to Yunyang, these skewers are ready, try it quickly." As he said that, Liu Yangyang took a few skewers from the small oven and placed them in front of Yunyang.
"...I haven't finished eating yet."
"What's the big deal? Just eat more."
Yunyang looked at the iron picks piled up next to his tableware, and felt an inexplicable feeling that he had been cheated.
Aren’t you here to be a wingman? Why do you feel like you are almost becoming a host?
Look at that guy Zhang Gu again.
Zhang Gu, who was sitting opposite Li Ziran, who was straight and black, was very attentive, but Li Ziran didn't seem to appreciate it very much. He occasionally replied with a mild "Hmm.", "Ah.", "Really?", and was quite indifferent to Zhang Gu.
Yunyang, Xue Zijie and Zhao Jiang looked at each other, and the three of them frowned slightly.
Something is wrong with this game today. Who is acting as a wingman for whom?
Yunyang raised his chin and signaled: Zhu Aiqing, come up with some ideas quickly!
Xue Zijie looked at Yunyang and indicated with his eyes: Your Majesty, the matter is over, why don't we change the target and treat you as the host.
Be your sister! It’s none of my business!
Yunyang pursed his lips towards Zhang Gu.
Don't forget the main task tonight! It’s to help that boy Zhang Gu!
Immediately, Yunyang raised his eyebrows at Xue Zijie and Zhao Jiang and said: "I'm going to eat here, and it's useless for him to be courteous. Seeing that the place is getting colder, you guys should quickly show some subjective initiative and find some topics to talk about!"
topic?
Zhao Jiang came up with a plan, looked at the Internet cafe store not far away and then looked at Yunyang, indicating with his eyes: How about talking about games?
…
Who recruited Xiao Zhao? Drag him out and behead him!
Look at the four girls across from you, a carefree legal loli who hangs out among boys every day, a fashionable girl with wavy blond hair, a straight IK girl with long black hair, and a tall, single ponytail named Bai Yueguang. Guess who among them is most likely to like playing games?
Aren't you pushing me into the fire pit?
Take Xiao Zhao’s body out and whip it!
"Crack!"
Xue Zijie patted Yunyang's shoulder.
